newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nepal tenders to buy kerosene, diesel for May.
newsitem.headline: Nepal tenders to buy kerosene, diesel for May.

text.p: State-owned Nepal Oil Corp (NOC) has issued a tender to buy superior kerosene oil and high speed diesel for May deliveries, an NOC official said on Tuesday.
The tender seeks 30,000 tonnes of kerosene for May 1-10 delivery on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to the Indian east coast.
It also seeks the same volume of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel for May 21-31 delivery, c-and-f Indian east coast.
The tender closes on April 1 and offers will be valid until April 4.

In its last tender, Nepal bought diesel from German trader Mabanaft at $202.75 per tonne for March 11-20, c-and-f basis, and two kerosene cargoes from Dutch trader Vitol at $235-$240 per tonne, for March 1-10 and 21-31 deliveries, c-and-f.
